description:
We are testing the brand new Beelink EQi 304 Mini PC with the highly-efficient Intel Core 3 304 processor, and pushing it to the absolute limit.

Learn More Here: https://amzn.to/4wACTPy

This ultra-budget mini PC is hiding some serious potential under the hood. Powered by Intel's new Wildcat Lake architecture, this 5-core machine draws a maximum of just 32 watts from the wall. But the real surprise is the single-core Intel Xe3 iGPU. We put it through its paces in Windows 11, running everything from 4K video playback to modern AAA titles.
